source.title: WST Leader Announcement (June 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader! Gregor Billing will become the new Leader of the WCA Software Team (WST). Gregor was already working as a Senior member of the Team.
<!-- break -->
Gregor was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Gregor best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader is already promoted. There were no other applicants and the candidacy document of Gregor can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MYt5o7ml2_2KLDsfi2SFpg9sdhBqctIV?usp=sharing) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: WCA 软件组负责人任命公告（2021 年 6 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Gregor Billing 将出任 WCA 软件组（WST）的新任负责人！Gregor 此前已是团队的高级成员。

WCA 董事会依照[《关于 WCA 委员会与团队的议案》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节选出 Gregor，并经现任委员会负责人及高级代表投票确认。

祝 Gregor 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

新负责人已正式就任。本次没有其他申请人。如有兴趣，Gregor 的申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MYt5o7ml2_2KLDsfi2SFpg9sdhBqctIV?usp=sharing)查看。
